name: When is the best time to consider custom finish carpentry for a renovation?

mainEntity.name: When is the best time to consider custom finish carpentry for a renovation?

acceptedAnswer.text: The ideal time to consider custom finish carpentry for a renovation is during the planning phase, especially before major construction or painting begins. Integrating these elements early allows for seamless coordination with other trades, such as electricians for lighting in built-ins or painters for a consistent finish. Deciding early helps avoid conflicts with existing structures or finishes, ensuring the carpentry work fits perfectly into the overall design without needing costly adjustments later in the project.
acceptedAnswer.description: The best time to consider custom finish carpentry is during the planning phase of a renovation, before major construction or painting, to ensure seamless integration.
